name: Methscopolamine

summary: In hot weather, this drug can cause heat exhaustion, including fever and heat stroke, because it reduces sweating [3]. Loose, watery stools can also be an early sign of a partially blocked intestine, particularly in people who have had bowel surgery such as an ileostomy or colostomy [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores for liver and heart effects [M].
